title: Cardamom Currant Moscow Mule

items: 0.75 oz cardamom & Zante currant infused syrup
Optional: ginger candy and lime slice, for garnish

steps: Pour the vodka, lime juice, and syrup into a copper mug or highball glass filled with ice.
Top with ginger beer. Optionally garnish with ginger candy and a lime slice on a pick.
